sources.title: Phi4 Multimodal - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Phi4 Multimodal Phi4 Multimodal is a multimodal model capable of text, image, and speech and audio inputs or any combination of these. It features a mixture of LoRA adapters for handling different inputs, and each input is routed to the appropriate encoder. You can find all the original Phi4 Multimodal checkpoints under the Phi4 collection. This model was contributed by cyrilvallez. Click on ...
